DECISION: Maestro (not XCUITest) for iOS UI testing
OPTIONS: XCUITest (cannot test keyboard extensions at all), Maestro (OS-level, YAML flows, CAN test keyboard extensions)
REASONING: XCUITest fundamentally cannot test keyboard extensions; Maestro runs at OS level and can navigate Settings to install keyboard, switch to it in Notes, verify layout and tap buttons
INSTALL: brew install --cask maestro (requires Java 17+: brew install openjdk@17)
FILE LOCATION: .maestro/ at project root with flows/app/ and flows/keyboard/ subdirs
REVISIT WHEN: Maestro has breaking API changes or iOS version changes Settings UI again
